description: This source file defines a custom Android View called QiblaCompassView, which renders a compass UI element indicating the direction of the Qibla relative to the device's orientation. The class manages rendering, animations, and user interface elements such as tick marks, labels, and directional arrows.

classes.name: QiblaCompassView
classes.description: A custom Android View that displays a compass with Qibla direction indicator, allowing smooth animations as the direction updates.

methods.name: setQiblaBearingDegrees
methods.description: Updates the target Qibla bearing in degrees and triggers a smooth UI update.

methods.name: setDeviceAzimuthDegrees
methods.description: Updates the device's azimuth (compass heading) in degrees and triggers a smooth UI update.

methods.name: invalidateSmooth
methods.description: Calculates the difference between current and target bearing and animates the arrow if the change exceeds a small threshold.

methods.name: animateTo
methods.description: Animates the compass arrow from its current position to the target bearing.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the view's draw method to render the compass, tick marks, labels, and directional arrows.

methods.name: drawArrow
methods.description: Draws a directional arrow pointing at a given degree on the canvas.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Ensures an angle in degrees stays within the 0-360 range.

methods.name: shortestDelta
methods.description: Calculates the shortest angular difference between two degrees, considering circular wrap-around.
